title: List group
summary: A bordered list of rows: plain, actionable (links and buttons), with badges at the end, or a checklist.

props.name: checklist
props.description: Rows are labels with a checkbox.

props.name: dense
props.description: Compact rows for long lists of results or an outline: rows at text height with the children laid out inline from the start, and no 44px minimum on desktop (an actionable row still gets the touch target on a phone). A row can carry data-depth="1" to "3" to indent.

slots.description: Rows: div, a, button or label elements.

writes.why: A row without a role gets role=listitem so the list has the items the host role=list expects; a role the host set is left alone. Not removed. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: The host is role=list and each row gets role=listitem unless it already has a role. Rows are native links, buttons or labels, so keyboard and names come from them. The current row uses aria-current. Actionable rows are at least 44px tall; in a dense list only on a phone, where the touch target still applies. A focused dense row shows the focus ring inside its edge.

examples.title: Actionable with badges
examples.html: Receive PO 1042 Low stock

examples.title: Dense results with an indent
examples.html:
<pk-list-group variant="action" dense label="Outline">
  <button type="button">function render</button>
  <button type="button" data-depth="1">const rows</button>
  <button type="button" data-depth="2">const cells</button>
</pk-list-group>

examples.title: Checklist
examples.html:
<pk-list-group checklist label="Receiving">
  <label><input type="checkbox"> Count boxes</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" checked> Check slip</label>
</pk-list-group>
